name: mock-weakness
note: Synthetic answer-review counts (no learner data). Gates TYPESAFE__MOCKWEAKNESSENABLED (jev.mock.weakness). Mirrors JevMockWeakness.RankAsync: one Score (0..3 evidence scale) per candidate catalogue tag over compact counts; the report keeps tags with confidence >= 0.60 and score >= 1.5 (MinReportableScore), ordered by score then tag. Case `listening_spelling_skew`: every wrong Listening answer is a Part A spelling slip, Reading is clean apart from one miss, so listening_partA_spelling must rank first and the unrelated tags must stay below the reporting floor. Case `reading_partc_skew` is the mirror image (guards against a position bias in the candidate order). The state carries counts only, so there is no free-text injection surface to test.
